input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: tool project pages (writing/topic/tools/<slug>/) lead with the venture's llms.txt summary instead of a generic dek
errors: My first post description was 170 characters. The loader rejects anything over 160, so the site build failed and about 170 build.test / podcast / writing tests failed with it in the full `node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs'` run. I shortened it and reran the affected files.

doc_friction.issue: It suggests starting the full build in the background and screenshotting the built site. For a writing.mjs change, `node platform/pages/writing.mjs --out=<dir>` takes 4 s and gives a clean before/after diff. The full build was not needed, and running it at the same time as the test suite only muddied the results.

deviations.why: I didn't screenshot the hub, a flagship, research, Stories and a post before choosing. Three consecutive polish reports carried the same weakness (the generic tool project-page dek), so I picked it directly.
deviations.did: Took before/after screenshots of the changed page only
deviations.result: 17 of 17 pages fixed. Only the 17 intended files changed.

notes: The writing-only build before and after: diff -rq shows 17 changed files, all writing/topic/tools/<slug>/index.html. Specific dek on 0 of 17 pages before, 17 of 17 after. After the description fix: heading-order, podcast, writing-backlog and writing tests pass (71/71),. build.test.mjs + custom-domain tests: 320 pass, 1 fail. The failure was 'an identical build produces an identical cache name', and the test's own message says why: I edited docs/reports/polish-2026-11-16-tool-dek.md while the suite ran, so the two builds read different trees. It is not a builder fault.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: read three reports, write a parser with a test, before/after build diff, screenshots, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
